p: Choose a structure, add founders, clear KYC, pay the fee, sign, and record the founding allocation. Each step is one guarded transition of the formation machine, so an agent can drive it and cannot skip a step. The law needs a person three times — identity, signature and the fee — and after genesis the shares, rounds and documents are operations like any other.
